```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)
library(gridExtra)

save_path_data <- "Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/esp"
setwd(save_path_data)
price_indispo_merge <- read_parquet("price_indispo_merge_esp.parquet")%>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         # Planned.Unavailable.Capacity = Planned.Unavailable.Capacity - Planned.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity = Uneffective.Unavailable.Capacity - Uneffective.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity
)

setwd("Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/cross_border")
price_merge_CBF <- read_parquet("price_merge_CBF.parquet")

```

One focusing on the different modalities I have for Unavailabilities

```{r}

dayahead_price_indispo_data <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  mutate(Published.Unavailable.Capacity = Published.Unavailable.Capacity - Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
         Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity = Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity - Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,

  ) %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>% 
  summarise(
    Published = ifelse(all(Published.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Published.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                       0, 
                       mean(Published.Unavailable.Capacity[Published.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),

    Unpublished = ifelse(all(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                         0, 
                         mean(Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity[Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
    )


predict_dayahead_price_indispo_data <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  group_by(delivery_date) %>% 
  summarise(
    Published = ifelse(all(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                       0, 
                       mean(Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE)),

    Unpublished = ifelse(all(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity <= 0 | is.na(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity)), 
                         0, 
                         mean(Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity[Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity > 0], na.rm = TRUE))
  )

unavail_plot <- ggplot()+
  #geom_line(data = predict_dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= Date, y = -Planned, color = "Planned"))+
  #geom_line(data = predict_dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= Date,y = -Uneffective, color = "Uneffective"))+
  geom_line(data = predict_dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date,y = -Unpublished, color = "Unpublished"))+
  geom_line(data = predict_dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date,y = -Published, color = "Published"))+
  #geom_line(data = dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date, y = Planned, color = "Planned"))+
  #geom_line(data = dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date,y = Uneffective, color = "Uneffective"))+
  geom_line(data = dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date,y = Unpublished, color = "Unpublished"))+
  geom_line(data = dayahead_price_indispo_data, aes(x= delivery_date,y = Published, color = "Published"))+
  labs(x= "Time", y = "Plants Unavailabilities")+
  theme_minimal()

unavail_plot 
```

```{r}
setwd("Z:/prix_electricite_gitlab/day_ahead/outputs/esp")
filtered_indispo <- read_parquet("filtered_indispo_esp_OMIE.parquet")

publi_all_matched_indispo <- read_parquet( "day_ahead_indispo_formatted.parquet")

non_duplicated_indispo <- merge(filtered_indispo, publi_all_matched_indispo, 
                                by = c("mrid", "start_datetime", "end_datetime"))
indispo_rf  <- merge(
  non_duplicated_indispo,
```

```{r}

#non_duplicated_indispo$year <- year(non_duplicated_indispo$electricity_delivery_date)

plot_data <- non_duplicated_indispo %>% 
  mutate(electricity_delivery_date = as.Date(datetime_slot)) %>% 
  group_by(mrid) %>% 
  summarise(plant_type = first(plant_type),
            duration = first(duration),
            Unavailable.Capacity = mean(Unavailable.Capacity, na.rm = TRUE),
            electricity_delivery_date = first(electricity_delivery_date),
            production_resource_name = first(production_resource_name)
            ) %>% 
  group_by(plant_type) %>% 
  summarise(Unavailable.Capacity.mean = mean(as.numeric(Unavailable.Capacity)),
         n_indispo = n()) 


rf_indispo <- indispo_rf  %>% 
  mutate(electricity_delivery_date = as.Date(datetime_slot)) %>% 
  group_by(mrid) %>% 
  summarise(plant_type = first(plant_type),
            duration = first(duration),
            predicted_real_unavailability = mean(predicted_real_unavailability, na.rm = TRUE),
            duration_rf = n(),
            electricity_delivery_date = first(electricity_delivery_date),
            production_resource_name = first(production_resource_name)
            ) %>% 
  ungroup()

rf_plot_data <- rf_indispo %>% 
  filter(predicted_real_unavailability < -50) %>% 
  dplyr::select(electricity_delivery_date, predicted_real_unavailability, plant_type, duration_rf) %>% 
  group_by(plant_type) %>% 
  summarise(predicted_real_unavailability = mean(predicted_real_unavailability, na.rm = TRUE),
            duration_rf = mean(as.numeric(duration_rf, na.rm = TRUE) ),
         n_indispo = n())
```



```{r}
plot_data <- plot_data %>% 
  mutate(plant_type = ifelse(plant_type == "Fossil Brown coal/Lignite", "Coal/Lignite", plant_type))
rf_plot_data <- rf_plot_data %>% 
  mutate(plant_type = ifelse(plant_type == "Fossil Brown coal/Lignite", "Coal/Lignite", plant_type))
# Premier graphique: Unavailable Capacity par Fuel Type
plot1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_col(data = plot_data, aes(x = as.factor(plant_type), y = Unavailable.Capacity.mean, fill = plant_type), alpha=0.4) +
  labs(y = "Unavailable Capacity") +
  geom_col(data = rf_plot_data, aes(x = plant_type, y = -predicted_real_unavailability, fill = plant_type), 
           stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), # Désactiver le titre de l'axe des x
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12), 
        legend.position = "none")  # Désactiver les ticks de l'axe des x


# plot1 <-plot1 +
#   theme(legend.position = "none")
#   
# Deuxième graphique: Nombre d'indisponibilités (n_indispo)
plot2 <- ggplot() +
 geom_col(data = plot_data, aes(x = as.factor(plant_type), y = -n_indispo, fill = plant_type, alpha="Declared unavailability")) +
  geom_col(data = rf_plot_data, aes(x = as.factor(plant_type), y = -n_indispo, fill = plant_type, alpha="Effective unavailability"), 
           stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  labs( y = "Event count", fill = "Fuel type") +
  theme(
    #legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm") , 
        legend.text = element_text(size = 15),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 14, angle = 30, hjust =1),
        axis.title.x = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12) )+
  scale_alpha_manual(name = "Unavailability", 
                     values = c("Effective unavailability" = 1, 
                                "Declared unavailability" = 0.4)) 
custom_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(plot2)

plot2 <-plot2 +
  theme(legend.position = "none")


  # Ajouter un titre personnalisé comme annotation
  #+annotate("text", x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = "Number of Power Outages", 
           #hjust = 1.4, vjust = -1.5, size = 5)
# Assembler les deux graphiques verticalement avec patchwork
combined_plot <- plot1 / plot2 #+ draw_plot(custom_legend, x = 0.8, y = 0.5, width = 0.2, height = 0.5)
# Combine the grid with the legend
final_plot <- plot_grid(combined_plot, custom_legend ,
                        ncol = 2, rel_heights = c(2, 0.1))



# Afficher le graphique combiné
final_plot
```

```{r}
sum_unavail <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  dplyr::select(
    Published.Unavailable.Capacity, Unpublished.Unavailable.Capacity,
    Published.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity, Unpublished.Unavailable.Nuclear.Capacity,
    Published.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity, Unpublished.Predicted.Unavailable.Capacity
  ) %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(.x[.x != 0], na.rm = TRUE)))


mean <- sum_unavail[1,1:2]
nuclear_mean <- sum_unavail[1,3:4]
predict_mean <- sum_unavail[1,5:6]


```


```{r}

library(gt)

data_dayahead_data <- data.frame(
  cbind(
    t(round(count)), t(round(mean, 1)),
    t(round(predict_count)), t(round(predict_mean, 1)), 
    t(round(nuclear_count)), t(round(nuclear_mean,1))
  )
)
rownames(data_dayahead_data) <- c("Published",  "Unpublished")
# Create a gt table with styling
# Convert data to a data frame and transpose it
gt_table <- as.data.frame(t(data_dayahead_data)) %>%
  mutate(
    Row_Label = c("Nbre", "Avg Unavailability", "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability", "Nbre", "Avg Unavailability") # Adding row labels
  ) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "Row_Label") %>%  # Set row labels
  tab_row_group(
    group = "All Declared",
    rows = 1:2  # Rows 1 and 2 for Predicted
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "Predicted",
    rows = 3:4  # Rows 1 and 2 for Predicted
  ) %>%
  tab_row_group(
    group = "Nuclear",
    rows = 5:6  # Rows 3 and 4 for Nuclear
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_borders(sides = "bottom", color = "gray", weight = px(2)),
    locations = cells_row_groups(groups = everything())
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.width = pct(100)
  )

gt_table
```

```{r}

dayahead_price_indispo_data <- price_indispo_merge %>% 
  group_by(year, month) %>% 
  summarise(
    Solar = mean(Solar, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    Wind_Onshore = mean(`Wind Onshore`, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    Renewable_Generation = mean(day_ahead_forecast, na.rm = TRUE)/1000,
    delivery_date = first(delivery_date)
    #Wind_Onshore = mean(`Wind Onshore`, na.rm = TRUE),
  )
#class(dayahead_price_indispo_data$delivery_date)
renew_plot <- ggplot(data = dayahead_price_indispo_data, 
                     # %>%filter(delivery_date <=as.Date("2023-01-01")),
                     aes(x = delivery_date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Renewable_Generation, color = "Renewable Total")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Wind_Onshore, color = "Wind Onshore")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Solar, color = "Solar")) +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Power (GW)") +
  scale_color_manual(
    name = "Energy",  # Legend title
    values = c(
      "Renewable Total" = "#1b9e77",
      "Wind Onshore" = "#d95f02",
      "Solar" = "#7570b3"
    )
  ) +
  theme(legend.text = element_text(size = 15),      # taille du texte
        legend.title = element_text(size = 16),     # taille du titre
        legend.key.size = unit(1.5, "cm") ,          # taille des symboles/rectangles,
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe x
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),   # taille du titre axe y
        axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 12, angle = 45, hjust = 1),  # taille et rotation des ticks x
        axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 12)    # taille des ticks y
  )


renew_plot
```
